summary: This dispatch registered the unregistered sources the All Saints research read, bound them to the leaf, and wrote the leaf's per-source commentary dispositions. Registered: work.jacques-paul-migne.patrologia-latina-volume-183 with its 1854 Paris edition, a remote Internet Archive scan, a tracked optical text, and a tracked facsimile excerpt of cols. 453-481; work.bernard-of-clairvaux.sermones-in-festo-omnium-sanctorum with its 1854 Migne PL 183 edition and segment cols-453-481; edition.thomas-aquinas.summa-theologiae.2026-10-27-english-dominicans-newadvent-prima-q23 with a restricted delivery artifact and a tracked normalized text. A PL 183 containment entry was added to source-containment-v1.toml. research/source-bindings.toml gained bindings 54-57 (Bernard segment, PL 183 scan, PL 183 optical text, New Advent ST I q. 23); bindings 1-53 are unchanged. research/source-dispositions.toml holds 65 rows. Admitted: Bede on the Apocalypse passages 1-7-4, 1-7-9, 1-7-10, 1-7-11, 1-7-12. Not-commentary: text control, Bible, Lasance, Durandus/Beleth, text layers, and the New Advent delivery. Deferred, for want of passage records, page-image collation, verified transcription, original-language text, recension identity, work records, attribution, or publishable rights: Schuster, Fromage, Victorinus, the Bede 7:1-3 scan, the PL 35 Expositio, Cyprian, Augustine (Enchiridion, De sermone Domini, Sermon 61, Enarr. in Ps 33), Gregory, Aquinas (ST, Super Psalmos, Super Matthaeum), Basil, Bellarmine, Chrysostom, Hilary, and Bernard and the PL 183 artifacts. research/scope.md was corrected: section 3.3 and section 10 now record the New Advent and Bernard sources as registered, and section 10 notes the migration-ledger snapshot defect. Checks: source-library validate valid (bindings=4321); proper-study source-dispositions and research check with --require-source-dispositions pass; commentary-work-index containment passes; make source-projection passes; source-reader check and structure --check pass; calendar-days, check-calendar-masses, mass-propers structure, calendar-rubrics and mass-ordinary checks pass; 91 locus-pattern, disposition and source-library unit tests pass. make -k check-sources fails only at check-document-catalogue (homily.tex and synthesis.tex not yet written, as expected), check-publication-inventories (claude-publications-v1.toml holds stale hashes and missing paths for the open f02 revision), and source-family-migration check (pinned canonical_catalog_snapshot is stale, as any new source record makes it).
